subject: Co-auth Blog Swap + Hands-on Demo Day — planning
content:
From: Maya Singh <maya@devsprint.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick idea — co-auth blog + hands-on demo day

Hi Lauren (and Karthik),

Hope you're both well — we loved Redwood's recent inference performance post. DevSprint is running a small partner series (3 partners, 1-day hands-on demo + a co-auth blog that pairs technical writeups) and we think Redwood would be a perfect fit.

High-level:
- Co-auth blog: one technical + one customer-facing piece we swap and cross-post.
- Demo day: half-day, online lab with 3 partner-led mini-sessions (30–40 mins each) with live Q&A and a follow-up GitHub repo.

Tentative dates: Nov 10 or Nov 17. We can host (we have a tested sandbox) but would ask Redwood to provide a short slide pack + one lab exercise.

Would love to sync a quick 30-min call next week to sketch scope and marketing responsibilities. I attached a very rough outline for the blog (draft_blog_outline.docx).

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Ecosystem, DevSprint
(attachment: draft_blog_outline.docx - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Maya Singh <maya@devsprint.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick idea — co-auth blog + hands-on demo day

Maya — thanks for the invite, this sounds actionable and aligned with our partner program goals. Karthik and I chatted briefly — Ben from Field Marketing should join the planning thread so we can coordinate promotion and registration.

Couple of immediate thoughts:
- Nov 10 works better for Redwood (Nov 17 conflicts with a customer summit).
- For the co-auth blog: Redwood can take the tech deep-dive (runtime optimizations + integration checklist) and DevSprint can write the partner case study. Swap dates: we publish within a week of the event.
- For the demo day: we can contribute a 35-min demo (live inference tuning + quantization walk-through) and a small hands-on lab (30–40 min). We ask that the sandbox provide 4 GPU seats for attendees to try the lab.

I've attached a shared runbook template and sketched slide requests. Can you confirm host infra and whether DevSprint will handle registration page + calendar invites? (attachment: event_runbook.xlsx)

If that aligns, I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Friday and loop in Ben to own co-promotion.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

- We can provision 6 GPU seats for the lab, but need service-account access from the hosts by Oct 28.
- We'll publish a short integration how-to that can slot into the co-auth blog.
- Marketing asks: can we get final speaker names by Oct 22 for the landing page?

Doc links: runbook looks good. I've uploaded a starter slide deck our speaker will use (slide_deck_v1.pdf).

Looking forward — Tom

Thanks everyone — quick align and action items: 
1) Confirmed event date: Nov 10 (virtual).
2) Infra: CloudForge to provision 6 GPU seats; Maya please share service-account/ssh instructions by Oct 28 so we can create the demo images and test KV-cache + quantization hooks.
3) Content: Redwood will write the runtime deep-dive (Lauren + Karthik), DevSprint will write the partner case study (Maya), CloudForge will contribute a short integration how-to (Tom). Drafts due Oct 29.
4) Marketing: Ben to own landing page + registration; need speaker bios + headshots by Oct 22.
5) Assets: I've uploaded a small redwood test script and a sample dataset to the shared Drive. Links in the runbook.

Next steps: Lauren to schedule a 30-min kickoff (Fri, Oct 22 @ 10:00am PT) — please accept if that works.

Karthik Iyer
